# Imported bare options bound to inferred locals must cross the export
# boundary as their representation. Lowering rewrites spelled option
# types, so a package whose lowering makes no edit keeps the inferred
# *types2.Option in its inline bodies; the export writer erases it.
# A nested neg module (own go.mod, outside ./...) proves callers still
# see T?: assigning the exported result to a plain pointer must fail.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd src
logos build ./...
logos lint ./...
logos run ./cmd
stderr 'body false: nil'
stderr 'body true: opt'
stderr 'var false: nil'
stderr 'var true: opt'
stderr 'ifinit false: nil'
stderr 'ifinit true: opt'
stderr 'switch false: nil'
stderr 'switch true: opt'
stderr 'closure false: nil'
stderr 'closure true: opt'
stderr 'param false: nil'
stderr 'param true: opt'
stderr 'local false: nil'
stderr 'local true: local'
stderr 'pass false: nil'
stderr 'pass true: opt'
cd neg
! logos build ./...
stderr 'cannot use'
stderr 'MyError\?'
cd ..

logos eject -o out
exists out/cmd/main.go
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- src/go.mod --
module example.com/optimportlocal

go 1.27

-- src/beta/beta.lgo --
package beta

type MyError struct {
	Msg string
}

func (e MyError) Error() string {
	return e.Msg
}

func New(msg string) *MyError {
	return &MyError{Msg: msg}
}

func GetOpt(make bool) *MyError? {
	if !make {
		return nil
	}
	return New("opt")
}

-- src/hole/hole.lgo --
package hole

import "example.com/optimportlocal/beta"

func Body(make bool) error {
	e := beta.GetOpt(make)
	if e == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return e
}

func VarNoType(make bool) error {
	var e = beta.GetOpt(make)
	if e == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return e
}

func IfInit(make bool) error {
	if e := beta.GetOpt(make); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return nil
}

func SwitchInit(make bool) error {
	switch e := beta.GetOpt(make); true {
	default:
		if e == nil {
			return nil
		}
		return e
	}
}

func Closure(make bool) func() error {
	e := beta.GetOpt(make)
	return func() error {
		if e == nil {
			return nil
		}
		return e
	}
}

func PassThrough(make bool) *beta.MyError? {
	e := beta.GetOpt(make)
	return e
}

-- src/ok/ok.lgo --
package ok

import "example.com/optimportlocal/beta"

func UseOpt(e *beta.MyError?) error {
	if e == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return e
}

func ReturnViaParam(make bool) error {
	return UseOpt(beta.GetOpt(make))
}

type LocalErr struct {
	Msg string
}

func (e LocalErr) Error() string {
	return e.Msg
}

func localOpt(make bool) *LocalErr? {
	if !make {
		return nil
	}
	return &LocalErr{Msg: "local"}
}

func ReturnLocal(make bool) error {
	e := localOpt(make)
	if e == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return e
}

-- src/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/optimportlocal/hole"
import "example.com/optimportlocal/ok"

func show(tag string, err error) {
	if err == nil {
		println(tag + ": nil")
	} else {
		println(tag + ": " + err.Error())
	}
}

func main() {
	show("body false", hole.Body(false))
	show("body true", hole.Body(true))
	show("var false", hole.VarNoType(false))
	show("var true", hole.VarNoType(true))
	show("ifinit false", hole.IfInit(false))
	show("ifinit true", hole.IfInit(true))
	show("switch false", hole.SwitchInit(false))
	show("switch true", hole.SwitchInit(true))
	show("closure false", hole.Closure(false)())
	show("closure true", hole.Closure(true)())
	show("param false", ok.ReturnViaParam(false))
	show("param true", ok.ReturnViaParam(true))
	show("local false", ok.ReturnLocal(false))
	show("local true", ok.ReturnLocal(true))
	show("pass false", ok.UseOpt(hole.PassThrough(false)))
	show("pass true", ok.UseOpt(hole.PassThrough(true)))
}

-- src/neg/go.mod --
module example.com/optneg

go 1.27

require example.com/optimportlocal v0.0.0

replace example.com/optimportlocal => ..

-- src/neg/neg.lgo --
package neg

import "example.com/optimportlocal/beta"
import "example.com/optimportlocal/hole"

// The caller still sees the option: assigning the exported option
// result to a plain pointer must not compile.
var _ *beta.MyError = hole.PassThrough(true)
